implementation_scope.en: Public cross-course validation and template only. Existing frozen rubrics and historic results are unchanged.
implementation_scope.zh: 仅包含公开的跨课程验证器和模板；既有冻结 rubric 与历史结果均不改变。

en: Each declared leaf has exact point-bearing criteria whose points total its maximum.
Each criterion has an explicit award condition and withhold condition.
A withheld criterion is deducted once for exactly its declared points; finer deductions require finer criteria.
Each leaf declares whether simplification, explanation, and visible working are required.
Unrelated extra content is ignored unless it directly contradicts a declared criterion.
A deduction trace references the exact applicable criterion ID.
zh: 每个已声明叶子都有精确的计分标准，且各标准分值合计等于该叶子的满分。
每条标准都必须明确写出给分条件与不给分条件。
未满足的标准只能按其声明分值扣一次；如需更细扣分，必须拆分为更细标准。
每个叶子都必须声明是否要求化简、解释和可见过程。
无关额外内容不影响评分，除非它直接矛盾于已声明标准。
扣分依据必须引用适用的精确 criterion ID。
